rules.applies_when: PCB work begins or schematic connectivity changes
actions: compare references pins nets and footprints
verify board outline holes keepouts and origin
record source revisions
acceptance: reference pin and net sets match authoritative schematic
every placed footprint maps to approved part
rules.failure_policy: stop layout/routing on any unexplained mismatch

rules.applies_when: physical constraints are defined or changed
required_inputs: current temperature rise impedance and safety inputs
actions: derive widths gaps vias differential and safety classes
record equation unit source and margin
map every critical net to a class
acceptance: no critical net uses an unexplained default rule
calculated requirement is no weaker than configured rule
unknown material or safety input blocks corresponding claim
rules.failure_policy: remain PLAN_ONLY until inputs are verified

actions: lock connectors holes antenna sensor and isolation boundaries
place power clock analog and decoupling by critical loops
check courtyard height orientation access and testability
acceptance: decoupling and critical loops satisfy component-source constraints
programming production and required test access remain available
rules.failure_policy: do not begin dependent routing for unresolved critical placement

rules.applies_when: tracks vias zones or planes change
actions: route critical nets by priority
maintain continuous return path
verify power loop neckdown vias and copper
refill zones and check islands
acceptance: no critical signal crosses a reference discontinuity without reviewed return path
power copper meets derived current/thermal rule
rules.failure_policy: report ROUTED only when criteria are met; otherwise EDITABLE_LAYOUT or PLAN_ONLY

actions: run actual DRC
bind violation to rule net and coordinate
fix and rerun
reopen board after save
acceptance: mandatory DRC error count is zero
each remaining warning/waiver has owner reason scope and revision
report input hash matches current board
rules.failure_policy: DRC failure blocks fabrication claim; missing tool is NOT_RUN

actions: generate Gerber drill PnP BOM and assembly outputs
independently view/read back outputs
verify layers holes slots coordinates and versions
hash every file
acceptance: manifest contains all required outputs and no stale mixed revision
layer and drill mapping match current board
PnP/BOM references and coordinates reconcile with board
rules.failure_policy: label FAB_FILES_CHECKED only after readback; generation alone is insufficient
